Yusuf Greets Kwankwaso On 70th Birthday by LEADERSHIP News 7 seconds ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram Kano State Governor, Alhaji Abba Kabir Yusuf, has congratulated the former Governor of Kano State Senator Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, on the occasion of his 70th birthday.
According to a statement issued by the governor’s Spokesperson Sanusi Bature, Governor Yusuf described the milestone as an important occasion to celebrate Senator Kwankwaso’s life, leadership and contributions to the development of Kano State and Nigeria.
The Governor acknowledged Kwankwaso’s role in the state’s political development, noting that the birthday provides an opportunity to reflect on the former governor’s years of public service and his contributions to governance, infrastructure development and the growth of democratic participation in Kano State.
He prayed to Almighty Allah to grant him good health, long life and renewed strength to continue contributing to the development of the state and the nation. The governor also wished him more years of peace, happiness and fulfillment as he celebrates this important milestone.
Kano Gov. Congratulates Ekiti Counterpart on Second-Term Inauguration
Kano State Governor, Alhaji Abba Kabir Yusuf, has congratulated his Ekiti State counterpart, Biodun Oyebanji, on his inauguration for a second term in office.
Governor Yusuf described the occasion as a significant milestone in Oyebanji’s political career and a testament to the confidence reposed in his leadership by the people of Ekiti State.
The Governor expressed optimism that Oyebanji’s second term would provide another opportunity to consolidate his achievements, strengthen democratic governance, and accelerate development across Ekiti State.
He urged the Ekiti State Governor to remain committed to people-oriented policies, inclusive governance, and programmes aimed at improving the living conditions of citizens.
Governor Yusuf, who was represented by his deputy, Murtala Garo, at the inauguration, also emphasised the importance of cooperation among state governments in promoting national unity, economic growth, and sustainable development.
He wished Governor Oyebanji and his deputy, Monisade Afuye, a successful and productive second term in office.
